rows.title: Absolute non-refoulement

rows.legal_effect_and_grain: An unamendable limit on entry refusal, return, removal, transfer, handover, and onward-transfer chains.

rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One individual judicial transfer authority with reasons, suspensive appeal, non-refoulement and justice-protection bars, and own T3 contract.

rows.title: Mutual legal assistance
rows.source_anchor: new-book-plans/book-1-public-safety-defence-emergency-and-external-power-decision.md::Mutual legal assistance may not be used
rows.source_needle: Mutual legal assistance may not be used
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One international evidence/cooperation authority bounded against laundering unlawful acquisition or enabling categorical wrongs.

rows.source_needle: A standing defence force is permitted, not required.
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One democratically authorized external-only force structure with Assembly ceiling, ordinary appropriation, audit, and no civilian jurisdiction.

rows.source_needle: The armed forces may assist civil authority
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One individually authorized, public, time-bounded, reviewed, unarmed assistance act carrying no coercive power.

rows.title: No delegation of coercive public force
rows.source_anchor: new-book-plans/book-1-public-safety-defence-emergency-and-external-power-decision.md::## 14. Defence: force structure and civilian command
rows.source_needle: ## 14. Defence: force structure and civilian command
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: A categorical non-delegation limit covering mercenaries, paramilitaries, armed groups, and private arrest/detention/search/interrogation/crowd/lethal power.

rows.title: Civilian-weapons regulation
rows.source_anchor: new-book-plans/book-1-public-safety-defence-emergency-and-external-power-decision.md::**Civilian weapons** are a matter for democratic law
rows.source_needle: **Civilian weapons** are a matter for democratic law
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One ordinary-law regulatory family requiring evidence, equality, proportionality, review, and neither constitutional arms right nor general disarmament power.

rows.title: Prior authorization of force abroad
rows.source_needle: Either requires **prior Assembly authorisation**
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One objective/legal-basis/scope/geography/means/duration/reporting deployment authorization with published reasons and own T3 contract.

rows.source_needle: An immediate defensive response to an actual attack may begin
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One narrow pre-ratification response that ends absent prompt Assembly ratification.

rows.title: Foreign deployment
rows.source_anchor: new-book-plans/book-1-public-safety-defence-emergency-and-external-power-decision.md::no armed force, covert action, targeting programme, or foreign deployment

rows.title: Arms-transfer authorization
rows.source_needle: **Arms transfers** require an evidenced test
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One evidenced transfer-control decision with independent review, reporting, and suspension on credible misuse evidence.

rows.source_needle: Every protective function requires an independent integrity route
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One abuse/integrity investigation outside the actor's chain, separate from force-incident and intelligence oversight.

rows.title: Treaty negotiation
rows.source_needle: Treaties are negotiated by the executive
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One executive negotiation act; it creates no binding effect without the separate ratification route.

rows.title: Treaty ratification
rows.source_needle: require Assembly ratification.
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One Assembly treaty-consent act with additional Council/region consent for regional competence or boundary effects.

rows.source_needle: ## 17. Treaties, external trade, sanctions, and no evasion

rows.title: Treaty and trade cannot lower the corridor
rows.source_needle: **No treaty, trade agreement, investment protection
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: A substantive supremacy limit; current machinery does not semantically verify treaty text or concealed lowering effects.

rows.source_needle: ### 19a. Before, during, and after a lawful exit
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: A categorical mandate boundary: only legal invalidity, imminent-life-threat policing, and negotiation remain available.

rows.legal_effect_and_grain: An express competence boundary preventing enumerated families from collapsing into residual authority.

rows.title: Protected local budget control
rows.source_needle: ## 1. Decision

rows.title: Protected local administration control

rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One irreducible local administration authority; administrative convenience cannot retract the local minimum.

rows.source_needle: ## 1. Decision
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One irreducible local authority to manage public spaces, bounded by standing, equality, liberties, floor, due process, and commons limits.

rows.title: Protected local facility management

rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One irreducible local authority to manage local facilities, distinct from assigned-service administration.

rows.title: Protected local assigned-service administration
rows.source_needle: ## 1. Decision
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One irreducible local authority to administer constitutionally or regionally assigned services; it makes no delivery or capacity claim.

rows.source_needle: ### Courts and independent institutions
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One independent recipient body with a duty to act on qualification referrals, continuity and remedy for inaction, and no allocation to audit by implication.

rows.title: Caregiving recognition module

rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One direct legal-effect recognition module for caregiving; it does not create omnibus family authority or compulsory personal care.

rows.title: Household recognition module
rows.source_needle: ## 4. Modular family recognition
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One direct legal-effect recognition module for household status; co-residence alone does not silently create every family consequence.

rows.title: Support recognition module
rows.source_needle: ## 4. Modular family recognition
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One direct legal-effect recognition module for support, distinct from assumed-duty enforcement and inherited support debt.

rows.title: Family property recognition module
rows.source_needle: ## 4. Modular family recognition
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One direct legal-effect recognition module for family property, bounded by equality, floor continuity, and separate succession rules.

rows.title: Family decision-agency recognition module
rows.source_needle: ## 4. Modular family recognition
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One direct legal-effect recognition module for decision agency; it cannot displace supported agency or become unbounded substituted choice.

rows.source_needle: ## 18. Evidence, records, and remedies

rows.title: Animal custody order

rows.title: Animal rehoming order
rows.source_needle: ## 18. Evidence, records, and remedies
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One final rehoming authority with welfare, continuity, evidence, and challenge, separate from temporary rescue or custody.

rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One adjudicated treatment effect grounded in species-appropriate evidence and care continuity.

rows.title: Animal rehabilitation order
rows.source_needle: ## 18. Evidence, records, and remedies
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One adjudicated rehabilitation effect, distinct from treatment, sanctuary, custody, and rehoming.

rows.source_needle: ## 18. Evidence, records, and remedies
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One final or continuing sanctuary-placement effect with welfare, continuity, evidence, challenge, and temporal status.

rows.title: Animal-use disqualification order
rows.source_needle: ## 18. Evidence, records, and remedies
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One adjudicated use-disqualification effect, separate from custody and licence action.

rows.source_needle: ## 18. Evidence, records, and remedies
rows.legal_effect_and_grain: One bounded monitoring effect with independent evidence, privacy, challenge, correction, end, and audit.

rows.source_needle: ## 18. Evidence, records, and remedies

rows.source_needle: ## 18. Evidence, records, and remedies
